tooltip.mechaniciancombat.armor_part.c1: C1 chestplate module. Only one module of each class can be installed.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.armor_part.c2: C2 chestplate module. Only one module of each class can be installed.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.armor_part.c3: C3 chestplate module. Only one module of each class can be installed.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.soul_chain.cha: Attacks have a 35% chance to chain through targets within 5 blocks for 70% and 50% damage.
message.mechaniciancombat.shield_blocked: Left Pauldron blocked the attack; 2 second cooldown
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.mechanician_un: Accessory-slot undersuit. Replaces the player body below the head and grants 3 armor.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.mechanician_ch: Chestplate and cloth drapes. Requires the Mechanician Undersuit.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.mechanician_le: Mechanician leg armor. Requires the Mechanician Undersuit.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.mechanician_bo: Mechanician boots. Requires the Mechanician Undersuit.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.portable_launc: Occupies the offhand as launch storage. Only fireworks, tipped arrows, wind charges, and tridents can be stored.
Swap from a launchable main-hand item; a finished cooldown restores all 3 charges.
Backpack projectiles fall at one-third gravity; Loyalty tridents return to the offhand first.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.auto_portable_: Uses fireworks from the offhand to attack visible targets automatically.
Press the action key to activate or stop; fires and highlights every second, switching targets after two shots.
Has 10 charges, restores 1 per second, and enters a 10-second cooldown when depleted.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.abyssal_ancien: An ancient cannon recovered from a lightless ruin and rebuilt to fire the Mechanician's ammunition.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.veritas_et_jus: A siege weapon named for truth and justice, unfolding to pass judgment on its targets.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.bowgun.descrip: A weapon rebuilt from siege engines used against great fortresses. A trained wielder can use this powerful siege weapon with extreme mobility to traverse the battlefield.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.bolt.effect: Full-charge throw; 2-block horizontal piercing radius; cannot be enchanted; focus interval x2
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.rose_quartz_bo: Locks onto a target within 6 blocks ahead and begins homing with a trail; a highlighted backpack target with clear line of sight takes priority until the highlight ends
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.armor_piercing: 8-pellet cone; 12-block range; 10% velocity loss per block; 5-block cone radius; 2.5-block damage radius; focus interval 80%
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.summon_antenna: Press the action key to deploy; marking is locked until deployment finishes.
After deployment, press the action key to mark a nearby entity within 20 blocks of the crosshair.
Press again to summon a Molten Golem; without a target it appears up to 8 blocks along the crosshair.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.missile_box.in: Installs below the Jump Backpack Thruster and requires it to be active.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.missile_box.ma: Hold the action key to mark one visible target every 0.05s, up to 6.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.missile_box.fi: Release to alternate cold-launched fireworks from both sides; each ignites and tracks after about 2 blocks. 6 second cooldown afterward.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.war_banner.ins: Installs in the backpack turret slot and occupies the offhand.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.war_banner.ski: Press X while on the ground and not holding a gun to deploy the banner.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.war_banner.aur: Allies within 8 blocks gain Absorption and Strength for 15 seconds; 60 second cooldown afterward.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.jump_backpack_: Replaces the upper-right launcher module. Press jump while grounded to climb to three blocks.
Then boosts forward. Hold jump to climb as high as six blocks.
Thrust drains energy and falling restores it; depleted energy must fully recharge before another launch.
hud.mechaniciancombat.summon_antenna.dor: Summon Antenna: press X to deploy
hud.mechaniciancombat.summon_antenna.arm: Summon Antenna: press X to mark
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.hunter_spear.d: Right click: consume the spear, play the deployment skill, and assemble the turret at the marker.
tooltip.mechaniciancombat.hunter_spear.r: After eight ironfounder bolts or when the owner leaves 15 blocks, the spear automatically returns to its thrower.
Add at least one ingredient and an output item
